methodology.owner: LP position owner from event.provider, not transaction sender.
methodology.activeLiquidity: Position shares / bin total shares times scaled reserves at pinned blocks. Ethereum defaults to storage reconciliation. BNB and Robinhood default to replaying LiquidityAdded/Removed and BinSwapped from pool creation, with atomic bin accumulators and finalized-block hash guards. Archive RPC overrides select storage reconciliation. Each valuation source is disclosed.
methodology.ranking: Top 1/5/10% among fully USD-valued, positive active LP portfolios. Unpriced or unverifiable active portfolios are excluded and disclosed. This is a separate population from trader-volume rankings.
methodology.deposits: Cumulative adds and removals, both token legs, normalized with verified immutable scale multipliers. USD cash flows are repriced using latest synced metadata quotes; these are not historical execution USD and are not profit.
methodology.coverage: Each chain is valued at its own finalized indexed block. Cross-chain snapshot timestamp is the earliest chain timestamp; individual block cutoffs are provided. Trader comparisons retain the trading snapshot cutoff.

methodology.user: Unique transaction sender (tx.from), deduplicated across chains. Relayers, bots, solvers and account-abstraction bundlers may represent other users.
methodology.volume: Sum of one token leg per pool Swap. Multi-hop routes can count multiple pool swaps in one transaction; this measures pool-level turnover attributed to transaction senders, not user deposits or profit.
methodology.pricing: USD estimates: allowlisted stablecoin quantity at $1; otherwise latest metadata spot price, not historical execution USD. Unpriced swaps remain in user/activity counts and are excluded from volume.
methodology.cohort: Top ceil(N / 100) addresses by estimated volume; ties at cutoff included. Small cohorts can exceed 1%. Not a profitability or smart-money signal.
methodology.coverage: All chains use the common covered time interval. All-time count is available only after scanning every registered pool from creation. 24h/7d activity is measured at the indexed cutoff, not browser time.
